requirements.title: 构造后赋值拒绝目录越界，防止在基础目录外创建目录
requirements.quote: Reject an ``appname``, ``appauthor`` or ``version`` that leaves the base directory when set after construction.

requirements.title: 构造与后续赋值使用一致校验，对相同非法值抛出相同 ValueError
requirements.quote: The three attributes validate on assignment and the constructor assigns through them, so one check covers construction and later changes and raises the same `ValueError` for the same value.

requirements.title: 保留公开名称和 API 文档，允许 None，并保留 Windows 禁用作者目录的行为
requirements.quote: Names and API docs stay the same. `None` passes, and `appauthor=False` keeps dropping the author directory on Windows.

requirements.title: 实例属性字典改为列出三个私有存储名称
requirements.quote: `vars(dirs)` lists `_appname`, `_appauthor` and `_version` in place of the public names.

open_questions: diff 新增测试要求合法 appname 赋值立即改变生成路径；PRD 明确描述了赋值校验，但未明确说明合法赋值后的路径更新契约，需确认该行为是否属于本次验收要求。
